title: Field Install Tactical — Weekly Sprint Notes (Oct 2026)
content:
Purpose:
Weekly tactical capture for field install activities, focused on VPC/on-prem installs this sprint, outstanding customer blockers, and short-term mitigation plans. This doc is intentionally lightweight — use it in standups, paste snippets into meeting notes, or link tickets directly.

Standup (2026-10-12) — 09:30 PT — Attendees: Maya, Kenji, Priya, Ethan, Zoe, Ravi
- Quick wins since last week:
  - Completed customer network preflight for Acme Health (site A). No MTU issues after patching switch config.
  - Canary on-prem agent rollout (v2.3.1) validated in staging: startup times reduced ~17%.
  - Push of registry mirror automation merged (PR 228) — waiting for rollout schedule.

Incident/Blocker Summary (priority ordering):
1) ACME-HLTH-1 — BGP neighbor flaps during install (HIGH)
   - Symptom: Repeated BGP session resets between customer edge and our edge router during package download phase. Causes intermittent package transfer failures and long retries.
   - Recent findings: Customer control plane has dual-homed ISP with asymmetric AS path; neighbor timers set to low keepalive on their side.
   - Temporary mitigation: Increased our hold timer to 180s on the deployment appliance and switched downloads to checkpointed S3 mirror (reduces long-lived TCP flows).
   - Owner: Kenji Sato. ETA for next action: 2026-10-14.
   - Next steps: Coordinate with Acme network team to align timers and schedule a maintenance window to test stable BGP session and swap to primary mirror. Jira: ENG-1692.

2) ZEN-EDGE-2 — HSM/KMS sign-on failures in air-gapped on-prem config (MEDIUM)
   - Symptom: Certificates not loading when HSM token is present; service falls back but audit logs show missing key usage.
   - Investigation: HSM middleware package version mismatch (pkcs11 shim 1.2.5 vs expected 1.3.0). Shim uses a new login flow; our agent does not handle the new session flags.
   - Mitigation: Roll agent with compatibility shim (local build) that explicitly handles both session flags. POC by Ethan done; needs integration test.
   - Owner: Ethan Morales. Blocker: build infra for signed shim image; follow-up ETA 2026-10-15.

3) ORBIT-ONPREM-7 — Registry mirror auth token expiry mid-install (LOW)
   - Symptom: Long installs on slow links fail because auth token to the private mirror expires after 20 minutes; current retry logic assumes short lived requests.
   - Fix: Update mirror client to refresh token proactively and implement resumable downloads. PR queued in staging.
   - Owner: Priya Kapoor. ETA 2026-10-18.

Standup notes / ad-hoc discussion highlights:
- Network debug toolbox: Zoe shared a checklist for remote capture (tcpdump filters, netstat commands, expected BGP states) — put into runbook soon. Action: Zoe to update runbook page: due 2026-10-16.
- On the Acme install, customer asks for hardened default MTU across the fleet — recommend standardizing on 9000 for internal links; note: validate impact on vendor-managed switches. Action: Maya to draft recommendation and send to Solutions Eng.
- Canary rollout telemetry: v2.3.1 agent metrics show 12% drop in memory transient spikes on startup, but two nodes reported OOM at 1h mark in stress test. Need to track if this surfaces in field. Action: Ravi to add memsampling probe to canary for next 48h.

Open actions tracker (short list):
- ENG-1692 (Kenji): Confirm BGP timer alignment with Acme, schedule 60-minute test window. (Due 2026-10-14)
- HSM shim integration (Ethan): Produce signed shim image and integration test logs; add to air-gap install checklist. (Due 2026-10-15)
- Registry mirror resumable download support (Priya): Merge token refresh + resume logic. (Due 2026-10-18)
- Runbook update (Zoe): Add network debug checklist + sample captures. (Due 2026-10-16)
- Canary mem probe (Ravi): Deploy probe alongside canary agents, report anomalies. (Due 2026-10-14)

Notes to self / parking lot (informal):
- Consider exposing a small downloadable depot for really constrained networks (sneakernet option); puts more on field teams, but reduces long TCP flows.
- Re-evaluate default retry backoff for package downloads — current linear backoff amplifies congestion on unstable links. Might need jittered exponential backoff.
- Add a short blurb in customer onboarding checklist about verifying BGP keepalive/hold timers — save a few installs.

Customer-specific appendices (short):
- Acme Health (site A): No hardware failures; main friction is BGP. Customer asked for whitebox of router logs — we requested export via secure SFTP.
- Zenith (edge customer): HSM token failures seen on two installs — correlation looks like older pkcs11 stacks on their infra. Zenith agreed to ship a test HSM for our lab.

Risks & mitigation (3-week horizon):
- Risk: Multiple customers running older pkcs11 or vendor middleware => repeated HSM integration work. Mitigation: Build a compatibility layer and publish standard HSM requirements to field onboarding.
- Risk: Slow links + token expiry/resumable downloads cause failed installs and engineer churn. Mitigation: Implement resumable mirrors + fallback to local USB depot for extreme cases.

Decisions made this week:
- Ship the agent compatibility shim as a stop-gap rather than delaying all installs for a full library upgrade. Trade-off accepted: temporary technical debt tracked under ENG-1744.
- Increase default BGP hold timer on appliance for installs by +60s to reduce flaps during package sync.

Meeting checklist for next sync (2026-10-15):
- Status update on ENG-1692 and HSM shim integration (5 min each).
- Review canary memprobe and any OOMs (10 min).
- Confirm whether registries resume logic merged and test plan for slow links (10 min).
- Quick review of customer onboarding note re: BGP keepalive (5 min).

Appendix: quick troubleshooting snippets (copyable)
- BGP brief check: sudo vtysh -c 'show ip bgp summary' | grep "Established"
- Capture: sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -s 0 -w /tmp/capture.pcap 'tcp and (port 179 or port 443) and host <customer-ip>'
- Verify HSM token: p11tool --list-tokens --token=0 --login (expect to see token label and slot)

If you have experimental notes or logs, paste here or link directly to ENG tickets. Keep this page as canonical weekly tactical for field install work — copy into handoff emails when escalations to Solutions/Support happen.

-- Maya
